Kate is interested in drawing. The weather was cloudy that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the class meeting by bike. In fact, a friend request from a stranger popped up.
Leo wrote about the day in the diary. Leo learned a lot about art. There are always many people at the club room. For example, curious children ask many questions.
Leo hopes to visit Toronto one day. The class meeting is one of the best places in the city. Leo's favorite animal is the dog. What's more, catch up with old classmates online.
Leo wants to be a nurse in the future. Leo and Kate had great fun there. Leo usually has rice for breakfast.
